omniverse.page.extremely_primordial_pear: Combine the power of eight primordial pearls. The resulting pearl is also required for infinity catalysts and remains after crafting.
omniverse.page.akashic_record: Use an Akashic Record to gain 999 research points in every registered aspect. The record is consumed outside Creative mode.
omniverse.page.magic_bee_products: Process infused combs in a Forestry centrifuge for magic wax, a chance of a byproduct and matching propolis. Centrifuging that propolis gives normal propolis and a 90% chance of crystal dust. Craft four matching dusts into one infused shard. Intellect, temporal and soul combs have their own products. Consult the recipe viewer for processing probabilities.
omniverse.page.thaumium_scoop: The thaumium scoop has 30 durability, accepts thaumium ingots for repairs and supports Repair enchantments.
omniverse.page.thaumium_grafter: This grafter has 15 uses and increases sapling drops through Forestry. Repair it with thaumium ingots. The Repair enchantment additionally causes exhaustion proportional to the square of its level.
omniverse.page.bee_frame_magic: The magic frame has 240 durability, doubles production speed and multiplies genetic decay by 0.6.
omniverse.page.bee_essence_life: Craft this essence with a magic frame to make a gentle frame. Its tooltip lists the production, lifespan, mutation and genetic decay multipliers.
omniverse.page.bee_essence_armor: Craft this essence with a magic frame to make a resilient frame. Its tooltip lists the production, lifespan, mutation and genetic decay multipliers.
omniverse.page.bee_essence_unstable: Craft this essence with a magic frame to make a metabolic frame. Its tooltip lists the production, lifespan, mutation and genetic decay multipliers.
omniverse.page.bee_essence_death: Craft this essence with a magic frame to make a necrotic frame. Its tooltip lists the production, lifespan, mutation and genetic decay multipliers.
omniverse.page.bee_essence_time: Craft this essence with a magic frame to make a temporal frame. Its tooltip lists the production, lifespan, mutation and genetic decay multipliers.
omniverse.page.bee_dimensional_singulari: Infuse the dimensional energy of ender pearls into three singularities using either recipe.
omniverse.page.bee_essence_oblivion: This essence consumes the dragon egg. Craft it with a proven frame for an oblivion frame: lifespan becomes one ten-thousandth of normal and production stops, while breeding remains possible.
omniverse.bees.feature_required: Requires Thaumic Omniverse Forestry bee integration
omniverse.page.bee_hive_deep: Attuned bees inhabit Deep Hives at Y=10–24 in hills, mountains and magical biomes, surrounded by at least five stone blocks. Infernal Hives occur in netherrack at Y=0–174, and rarely at Y=5–17 in hot or magical overworld biomes. Nearby deposits are redstone, quartz or glowstone respectively. Harvest with a Forestry scoop; a Silk Touch scoop moves the hive. Deep hives may yield rain-resistant Attuned or Valiant bees; Infernal hives occasionally yield Steadfast bees.
omniverse.page.magic_apiary: Craft a Forestry apiary with two unusual pollen and two enchanted drops. Arcane bees produce enchanted drops as a 9% specialty. The apiary accepts three frames, has base production of 0.9x and genetic decay of 0.8x. A provider can boost magic apiaries within six blocks.
omniverse.page.vis_aura_provider: Draws water, entropy and air from the vis network to double mutation chance, double aging speed, and raise production to 1.8x. Each charge costs eight network units (0.08 vis); each channel stores up to ten charges. Effects last 850, 400 and 300 ticks respectively, renewing when charges are available. Existing effects last until expiry after supply stops.
omniverse.page.bee_lore_fragment: Studious and Erudite bees, the second and third stages of the Mo’Bees scholarly branch, produce Lore Fragments as 2% and 5% specialties. Craft four fragments shapelessly into a Thaumcraft Knowledge Fragment. Specialty production still requires the species climate and flower conditions.
omniverse.page.bee_comb_air: Begin with Attuned bees from Deep Hives or native Mo’Bees Unusual bees. Cross these roots with Common for Cultivated, then cross a root with Cultivated for Eldritch. Cultivated x Eldritch yields Charmed; Eldritch x Charmed yields Enchanted; Charmed x Enchanted yields Supernatural. Arcane x Supernatural yields Ethereal. Supernatural x Ethereal yields Windy, Watery, Earthen or Firey with leaves, water, clay or lava beneath the housing. Use Forestry analysis and the recipe viewer for complete genomes and probabilities.
omniverse.page.bee_breeding.1: Self-cross each elemental predecessor with its matching infused crystal beneath the housing for an 8% chance of the corresponding thaumic bee. Ethereal x Arcane yields Order on an order crystal; Ethereal x Supernatural yields Chaos on an entropy crystal, both at 8%. Resource conditions examine the first non-housing block underneath a housing stack.
omniverse.page.bee_breeding.2: Ethereal x Infernal: Vis,9%,first quarter through last quarter across full moon. Attuned x Vis: Rejuvenating,8%. Vis x Rejuvenating: Empowering,6%,full moon bonus x1.322. Rejuvenating x Empowering: Nexus,10%,magical biome and aura node below. Transmuting x Empowering: Taint,11%,new moon. Transmuting x Rejuvenating: Pure,8%,magical biome and new moon. BigBad x Vis: Hungry,20%. Ethereal x Ghastly: Wispy,9%,waning through waxing crescent across new moon. Iron x Taint: Void,5%,magical biome at night. Moon days change at noon as in the original.
omniverse.page.bee_breeding.3: Vis restores node aspects, Rejuvenating repairs node quality, and Empowering permanently expands capacity. Taint, Pure and Hungry change node type. Effects operate on permanent node state and never promote temporary amplifiers into permanent capacity. Node flowers accept normal and energized nodes without creating new nodes. Thaumic flowers accept shimmerleaf and cinderpearl; native Forestry pollination remains available.
omniverse.page.bee_breeding.4: Skulking x Pupil yields Brainy at9%. Common x Skulking yields Chicken, Beef or Pork at12% in forest, plains or mountain biomes respectively. Brainy produces zombie brains; meat bees provide matching meat nuggets. Brainy bees summon brainy zombies only near players without a complete protective apiarist suit. Animal bees summon their animals within local population caps. Wispy bees summon wisps when space and difficulty allow.
omniverse.page.machine_ports.0: Add aspect ports to the machine pattern definition. Only ports inside the matched structure participate. Input ports supply recipes; output ports receive products. Essentia uses whole units. Vis uses hundredths of a point: 100 units equal 1 vis. The two resources are distinct.
omniverse.page.machine_ports.1: Capacity is independent for each aspect. Tier 1 holds 64 essentia or 100 vis units. Each tier doubles capacity through tier 11: 65536 essentia or 102400 vis units. Tiers 12 through 16 retain that limit. Right-click for contents and side controls; sneak-right-click toggles a face. Breaking a port loses its stored resources: empty it first.
omniverse.page.machine_ports.2: Essentia inputs have suction 128 and pull up to one unit per enabled face every 10 ticks. Vis inputs draw up to 10 units of each primal from the network every 10 ticks. A bridge draws up to 1000 units per primal every 10 ticks from its selected adjacent vis output. It holds 10000 per primal and supplies the vis network within 8 blocks. Its absorption face starts disabled.
omniverse.page.machine_ports.3: This port supplies new crafting recipes using thaumium, plain casings, glass and an essentia jar or vis relay. Upgrade with earlier ports and thaumium; a redstone torch switches input/output variants. The recipe viewer lists aspect requirements. Pack authors can use thaumicfutures:essentia and thaumicfutures:vis requirement types; see the included interface documentation.
tc.research_page.ALCHEMICALBRASS.1: You have discovered that Instrumentum transforms copper into a workable golden alloy. Drop a copper ingot into a crucible containing six points of Instrumentum to obtain alchemical brass, suitable for precise fittings and mechanisms.
omniverse.page.restored_materials: Alchemical brass packs into blocks or nuggets. As in Thaumcraft 6, rare earths occasionally drop alongside ores, except with Silk Touch. The resonators are arcane components. Recipes use the corresponding metal plates, falling back to ingots only if the pack supplies no such plate.
omniverse.page.restored_sponge: Absorbs flux goo and gas in a 7×7×7 area, becoming wet. Using it on a crucible empties its contents without flux. Restore it with 4 Aqua and 4 Permutatio.
omniverse.page.restored_urn: Creates water for free and fills nearby containers. Supplying 1 cv/t Aqua increases generation and delivery rates by 100×. No vis is spent when both the urn and nearby containers are full.
omniverse.page.restored_smelter: Thaumium: 4× smelting, export and capacity with 90% yield. Void: 2× speed/export, 8× capacity and full yield, with occasional nearby shocks while working. Both support ten alembics and bellows. Auxiliary pumps add alembic columns to alchemical furnaces.
omniverse.page.restored_transceiver: Attach the rear to essentia tubing. Exporters fill jars within sixteen blocks in front; importers draw from those jars according to the connected pipe's suction.
omniverse.page.restored_charms: The Cloud Ring grants one extra jump before landing. The Charm of Undying is consumed on lethal damage, restoring one health and granting regeneration and absorption.
omniverse.page.restored_voidseer: The pearl grants vis discount based on permanent warp, up to 10%. Multiple pearls do not stack. It also adds a small equipment warp penalty.
omniverse.page.restored_paradox: Thrown paradox matter detonates on impact. It has no further effect beyond the explosion.
omniverse.page.restored_celestial: Aim a thaumometer at the unobstructed sun, moon or stars; its lens shows the celestial name. Paper is required for both first-scan research points and notes. Record at most one note per world day. Without paper neither reward is granted. Use notes for related research points.
omniverse.page.restored_nitor: Dyed nitor retains its light and crucible-heating properties.
omniverse.page.restored_curios: Study curiosities for 1–8 research points in each of three related aspects. Each kind includes a different primal aspect. Find them in ruins, creatures and thaumic treasures.
omniverse.page.planted_crystals: Plant primal shards on their matching infused ore, including deepslate. Planted crystals never generate naturally. Four growth stages yield 1–4 shards; nearby matching ore permits propagation up to generation four. Growth and propagation consume 10 vis from the nearest matching ordinary node within 16 blocks when its charge is above 75% and above 10. At 10 or less, crystals shrink and return up to 10 vis. A final isolated seed survives.
omniverse.page.arcane_crafter: Click empty cells to disable them. Each rising redstone edge crafts once into the inventory in front, or ejects the output if no inventory exists. Insert a wand with a bound Soul Core: its owner's live research unlocks arcane recipes, and the wand pays their vis. Relays recharge the wand on top. Ordinary crafting recipes also work.
omniverse.page.restored_ancient_altar: Build the usual altar with a matching matrix, central pedestal, four lower brick blocks and four upper stone blocks. Wand-use assembles the columns; breaking the main structure restores them. Peripheral pedestals may be mixed. Ancient: 10% faster cycles, 10% nominal cost reduction, +1 instability; each ancient peripheral pedestal gives 1% nominal reduction. Reductions above 10% have diminishing returns and a hard 40% limit.
omniverse.page.restored_eldritch_altar: Build the usual altar with a matching matrix, central pedestal, four lower brick blocks and four upper stone blocks. Wand-use assembles the columns; breaking the main structure restores them. Peripheral pedestals may be mixed. Eldritch: 30% faster cycles, 5% more essentia, -2 instability; each eldritch peripheral pedestal adds 0.25% cost, each symmetric pair gives 1 stability. Reductions above 10% have diminishing returns and a hard 40% limit.
omniverse.page.restored_infusion_stones: Place directly beneath the four pillars. Each speed stone shortens the cycle by 10% and adds 1% cost; each efficiency stone lengthens it by 10% and gives 2% nominal reduction. Works with all three altar families. Reductions above 10% diminish toward a 40% cap.
omniverse.page.brass_exchange: Exchange exactly one nugget at a time. Alchemical brass to Create brass costs 2 Ordo and 2 Perditio vis; the reverse costs 1 each of Aer, Aqua, Terra and Ignis. No material is gained.
futures.page.ex_shards: Use Ex Deorum hammers on sandstone, nether bricks, grass, ice, smooth stone and TNT to obtain air, fire, earth, water, order and entropy shards respectively. Sand sieving yields amber and quicksilver drops (each 1/128 per mesh). Nitor supplies 1.5 times torch heat; tallow candles supply the same heat as a torch.
futures.page.ex_barrel: A heat-resistant Ex Deorum barrel retaining composting, rain collection, fluids and automation. A full bucket of witch water transforms obsidian into an obsidian totem. The special transformations require this barrel.
futures.page.ex_hammer: A diamond-tier Ex Deorum hammer, repaired using thaumium and compatible with Repair enchantments.
futures.page.ex_doll: Make a porcelain doll, then imbue it in a crucible. Add it to a full thaumium barrel of witch water. After 50 seconds, a Pech emerges into nearby free space. Peaceful difficulty and blocked space retain the paid summon until spawning is possible.
futures.page.ex_freezing_doll: With Thermal installed, add this doll to 1000 mB of water in a thaumium barrel to summon a Blizz after 50 seconds.
futures.page.ex_filter: String meshes can form a vis filter without naturally occurring materials.
futures.page.ex_matrix: Mixed crystal clusters, arcane stone and an ender pearl form a runic matrix.
futures.page.ex_vishroom: Transmute a brown mushroom into vishroom.
futures.page.ex_greatwood: Infuse a jungle sapling with six buckets of witch water, shimmerleaf and cinderpearl.
futures.page.ex_silverwood: Salis mundus, mana beans and diamond blocks refine greatwood into silverwood.
futures.page.ex_portal: Use on natural ground to create a seven-block-wide obelisk ring, aura node and linked outer lands maze. Leave the full site clear above, with natural terrain below; protected blocks, containers and unloaded chunks prevent placement. The usual eye ritual opens the portal.
futures.page.ex_hives: Make a trap from a hay bale and string mesh, then infuse it in 1000 mB of witch water in a thaumium barrel. Tallow, quicksilver or amber creates curious, unusual or resonant hives. Native Forestry scoops harvest the resident bees.
futures.page.ex_advanced_hives: Infuse a trap with stone, nether bricks or end stone to create deep, infernal or oblivion hives. Each contains its corresponding native Forestry bee population.
message.thaumicfutures.eldritch_portal_s: Requires a loaded, unprotected 7×7 natural site, clear above (4 blocks below, 7 above).
thaumicfutures.page.focus_shard.1: Aim at a visible living target within 32 blocks and use the wand to launch a purple vis shard. Every second it steers toward its target, slowing between pulses and bouncing off blocks. It disappears on hitting a creature. Potency increases its damage.
thaumicfutures.page.focus_shard.2: At rank five, Persistent lets the shard seek another creature of the same type within 16 blocks if its target dies, disappears or moves too far away. Shards last up to 15 seconds. Each cast uses 1 Aer, Ignis and Perditio; Persistent adds 1 Aqua.
thaumicfutures.page.focus_grapple.1: Launch an elemental tether that pulls you toward its point of impact, helping you cross gaps and reach heights. Potency increases its flight time and therefore its range. Each cast uses 10 Aer and Aqua.
thaumicfutures.page.focus_grapple.2: Sneak to detach, or fire a new grapple to replace the old one. A normal tether detaches near its anchor or when progress stops. Sticky, available at rank three, keeps it attached until you sneak or its anchor block disappears.
thaumicfutures.page.focus_builder.1: Sneak-use a normal block to select your building material, then aim at a block face within 64 blocks. The preview shows a line extending from that face, ending before your own coordinate. Use the wand to build with blocks from your inventory.
thaumicfutures.page.focus_builder.2: Following the original endpoint rule, the base line places up to 15 blocks. Each Enlarge rank adds 8, up to 55. Existing normal blocks are replaced and their ordinary drops returned to your inventory. Each successful placement uses 1 Aer, Terra and Ordo. Containers, unbreakable blocks and multi-block structures such as doors and beds are excluded. World protection remains in effect.
If its target is lost or moves out of range, the shard seeks a nearby target of the same type.
focus.upgrade.thaumicfutures.sticky.name: Sticky
focus.upgrade.thaumicfutures.sticky.text: The tether remains attached when you reach its anchor. Sneak to detach.
thaumicfutures.autocaster.tooltip: Mount on a block face and insert a wand with an attack focus.
thaumicfutures.autocaster.wand_slot: Insert a casting wand or staff with an attack focus. Sceptres cannot cast.
thaumicfutures.autocaster.battery_slot: Optional EU battery or battery pack, used only by the EMT energy ball focus.
thaumicfutures.page.autocaster.intro: Combining the Arcane Bore aiming mechanism with a Brain in a Jar produces a machine that casts spells with a real wand. Mount it on any solid block face, then right-click to insert a wand carrying an offensive focus. Wands and staves work; crafting sceptres do not. The head turns to track visible targets.
thaumicfutures.page.autocaster.supply: Spells draw directly from the inserted wand. Cap discounts, Frugal and other focus upgrades still apply. There is no separate vis tank or free aura charging. Connected nearby vis relays replenish the wand at the workbench charger rate, respecting capacity and recharge restrictions. EMT energy balls retain their EU cost: insert a charged electric battery or battery pack in the optional slot. Each shot costs 5120 EU.
thaumicfutures.page.autocaster.targets: The default targets are monsters. Animals and players can be enabled separately, with an explicit friendly-fire option; the owner and caster are always protected. Server PvP rules still apply. Range, sustained casting, projectiles and summons follow the installed focus. Casting stops when vis or line of sight is lost. Only the owner can manage the caster. Sneak-right-click to recover it; its wand and battery drop separately. It has 50 health, 4 armor and heals 1 health every 2 seconds.
thaumicfutures.crafter.busy: Another player is configuring this crafter.
thaumicfutures.crafter.cancel: Configuration cancelled; the previous pattern is retained.
thaumicfutures.dioptra.inspect: Hover a node to inspect it, or select one with the arrows below. The gold cross marks this dioptra.
thaumicfutures.dioptra.inactive: Insert an elemental or balanced shard and remove the redstone signal to survey nodes.
thaumicfutures.dioptra.controls: Drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom
thaumicfutures.page.dioptra.1:
The Thaumic Dioptra projects nearby aura nodes as a miniature three-dimensional survey. It covers a 13 by 13 chunk area centred on its chunk, through the entire build height. Projections retain the nodes' aspect colours, type and brightness and require no Goggles of Revealing.

Right-click with an elemental shard to display nodes containing that aspect. A balanced shard displays every node. An exhausted aspect remains detectable while its capacity exists.
thaumicfutures.page.dioptra.2:
Empty-hand right-click opens the detailed projection: drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, and hover or cycle through nodes to inspect coordinates, charge and capacity. The miniature on the device is scaled to the survey bounds and full build height.

Sneak-right-click empty-handed to remove the shard. Replacing the shard or breaking the device also returns it. Redstone pauses the survey and projection; a comparator reports the matching node count, up to 15.

Loaded nodes update each second. Unloaded chunks are read from existing saves without loading or generating chunks; their saved readings refresh about once a minute. The initial survey takes a few seconds.
thaumicfutures.page.arcane_pattern_craft:
The Arcane Pattern Crafter attempts one ordinary crafting-table recipe each second. It takes a single kind of material from the inventory above, fills the selected pattern, and sends the result and recipe remainders to the inventory below. It requires no vis; redstone pauses it. Insufficient output space prevents consumption.

Click the knob on the lower front to cycle through ten original presets. All enabled cells use the same item and data; materials may be drawn from multiple stacks.

Right-click anywhere except the knob with a wand to configure a custom grid. Each click sets the next cell, left to right and top to bottom: ordinary clicks enable, sneak-clicks disable. The new pattern applies only after all nine clicks; disabling every cell stops crafting.

During configuration the panel shows your draft and the next cell, and crafting pauses. Switching items, leaving or disconnecting cancels the draft and preserves the previous pattern. Another player cannot interrupt your sequence. Clicking the front knob cancels the draft and returns to presets; further clicks cycle them.
thaumicfutures.page.automated_crossbow.1:
The Automated Crossbow is a sentry that aims at nearby monsters. Place it on the top of a solid block and right-click empty-handed to open its ammunition slot. It accepts ordinary, elemental and other modern arrow ammunition, preserving the arrow's effects. Every shot consumes a real arrow.

Its range is 24 blocks, with 20 to 60 ticks between shots depending on distance. It has 30 health, 2 armour and heals 1 health every 80 ticks.
thaumicfutures.page.automated_crossbow.2:
Place it on an upward-facing dispenser to reload automatically with a stack of suitable arrows when empty. Fired arrows remain recoverable; no free ammunition is created.

Only its owner may open the inventory or right-click it with a wand to recover the device. Remaining ammunition drops separately. It proactively attacks monsters and retaliates against attackers, while protecting its owner and allies. Player combat respects the server settings.

This version uses TC4's blank golem core in place of the original clockwork mind. The brass gear uses an installed addon's material when available, falling back to alchemical brass ingots.
tc.research_text.thaumicfutures:DIOPTRA: A spatial view of aura nodes
modifier.thaumicfutures.thaumic.descript: Thaumium grants upgrade slots: one per part on two-part tools, otherwise one per two parts, rounded up.
tc.research_text.thaumicfutures:GUIDE_BE: The thaumic branches of Forestry bees
tc.research_text.thaumicfutures:M_TC6_EL: I have seen beyond the bounds of infinity
thaumicfutures.page.guide_futures.intro:
The thaumaturges who came later did not stand still. The fifth and sixth ages left new devices, materials and wand foci behind; other scholars carried thaumaturgy into the apiary and onto barren islands.

This page is arranged by origin: restored sixth-age works lie to the west and fifth-age devices and foci to the north. Integration research to the east and south appears only when the matching mod is installed.

Translucent icons mirror research from other pages. Click one to jump to the original.
thaumicfutures.page.guide_futures.index:
Where to begin:

%1$s: restored works of alchemical brass, essentia and infusion.

%2$s: the dioptra, automated devices and three new wand foci.
thaumicfutures.page.guide_futures.exdeor: %1$s: building thaumaturgy from nothing on a barren island.
thaumicfutures.page.guide_futures.bees: %1$s: the thaumic branches of Forestry bees.
thaumicfutures.page.guide_futures.backpa: %1$s and %2$s: arcane upgrades for Sophisticated Backpacks.
thaumicfutures.page.guide_tc6.intro:
The thaumaturges of the sixth age rewrote many of the old arts. These entries restore the parts that fit this age, keeping this age's prerequisites.

Each group grows from a mirror of research on another page: %1$s leads to alchemical brass and household devices, %2$s to altars and charms, %3$s to celestial notes and curiosities, and %4$s to matter from the void.

Refined essentia and dyed nitor branch directly from this entry.
thaumicfutures.page.guide_tc6.index:
Alchemy: %1$s, %2$s, %3$s, %4$s

Essentia: %5$s, %6$s

Infusion: %7$s, %8$s, %9$s, %10$s

Observation: %11$s, %12$s, %13$s

The void: %14$s, %15$s

Light: %16$s
thaumicfutures.page.guide_tc5.intro:
Fifth-age thaumaturgy leans toward automation: machines observe, craft and stand guard, while new wand foci let a caster pursue, pull and build.

%1$s shows nearby aura nodes in three dimensions.

%2$s and %3$s build on golemancy, and %4$s mounts an entire wand inside a machine.

%5$s, %6$s and %7$s are three new wand foci, descended from the shock and equal trade foci.
thaumicfutures.page.guide_bees.intro:
When thaumaturgy meets Forestry, the hive begins to brew aspects.

Start from %1$s to find thaumic bees, keep them in %2$s, and learn their lineage through %3$s. %4$s explains the magic in the swarm, and tools such as %5$s make the work easier.

Hive products can be refined further in the crucible: %6$s is the first of the essences, and the line ends with %7$s.
thaumicfutures.page.guide_bees.exdeorum: On a barren island, %1$s can stand in for wild hives.
